self_review.kind: self review; no subagent or judging model

findings.conclusion: Actual shared-slot WRITE access violations, not the old protected reads. Layout v3 statically separates control and slots into two 4096-byte pages. Producer slot view becomes PAGE_READONLY while control remains PAGE_READWRITE. Mapping lifetime and control writability are assumed; this does not handle control-page failure, arbitrary unmapping or corruption.

Healthy and faulty stores use the same x64 memory XCHG, with fixed leaf unwind metadata. Runtime site bytes 48 87 11 and span 3 verified in every final case. Filter requires actual AV, write operation 1, exact instruction address, current TLS armed pointer, aligned owned-record destination, depth 1 and held local gate. Wrong PC, wrong destination and nested original read AV reach the outer test observer.

Successful original return is computed before publication. For 45 admitted write AVs, the finally path stops admission before gate release, clears the armed destination and restores capture TLS. All 24 invocations return the exact expected value in those cases. Six rejected write AVs and three original AVs propagate; only the explicit outer TEST observer catches them, and the interrupted invocation is not counted as successful.

Seven stores tested at first use and first wrap: odd stamp, sequence, four words, even stamp. Audit reconstructs exact partial slot contents from completed stores. Publication cursor does not advance on admitted fault, so partially written seq1 or seq9 never enters SQLite. Previously committed records remain valid; full 8-record prefix retained on wrap tests.

Independent read-only bridge, durable receiver and relay operate concurrently with one original-call worker. Target self-joins and unmaps after finite work, with three real launcher-loss continuations. Observer holds identity/wait handles only. New two-producer/ACK contention interleavings are not deterministically exercised here; do not reuse old read-fault race results as proof for this write variant.

Two rounds, six invariant failures each: old read-only filter loses one caller return after actual write AV; leaked gate remains 1; early publication advances cursor to 1 with odd stamp; broad filter swallows wrong site, wrong address and nested original exception. Early-publication negative still yields zero inbox rows due to other rejection barriers; no erroneous delivery is claimed.

Missing implementation preflight preserved; two successful native builds preserved. First build supports initial positives/negatives; final build additionally records actual instruction bytes and corrects a stale comment. Final 57 cases and second negative round use the same archived EXE. All 75 process cases, 375 actual exits and DB/WAL/SHM hashes independently audited.

VirtualProtect is deliberate fault injection inside the experiment; this is not a production no-syscall or latency proof. Retain tail_unknown and same_process_signaled-only proof limits. Next build a NEW variant for deterministic second-producer/ACK/consumer interleavings around real write AVs, especially first filter decision, stop-before-unlock and armed TLS isolation. Real identity/ABI, arbitrary lifetime, hot unload, CFG/CET and old breakpoint failure remain unresolved.
